title: Black Sonic Alchemy
note: The brief below is the author's, quoted. Nothing in this file is a paraphrase, and nothing here proposes content. A production file that summarises an author's intent has already begun rewriting it.

extent.note: A 4.5× expansion is not an edit pass. What fills 210 pages is the open question, and it is not answered here.

brief.quoted: excise grief around his cousin's loss and personal narrative
brief.toward: commonality of understanding that alchemy as a process of spiritual proportion

brief.quoted: metallurgy as a practice of angelic spiritual holiness that was documented as a offering in exchange for the property, for the right to visualize, to materialize, and manifest property
brief.owed: Which documentation. This is a historical claim with a source behind it or it is a figure; the manuscript needs to know which, because the two are written differently.

brief.quoted: I would like to be… because I wanna be opaque
brief.reading: Opacity as a stance the prose takes, not a difficulty it fails to avoid. It sits against the excised grief: the personal is removed and what replaces it does not explain itself either.
brief.owed: Confirmation of that reading. It is the single decision that most changes the book, and it rests on an interrupted sentence.

brief.quoted: activates all the modification and capitalism available, but does it with a conscious glitching mind

sources.owed: Not one of these is in this repository. Until at least the mosaic is, every production step here is a plan about a document nobody working on it has read.

refuses: Drafting a page before the mosaic is in hand
Deciding what 'opaque' means on the author's behalf
Treating the cousin's loss as material to be repositioned rather than removed
